observed_route_limits: The 720p ordinary-input run ended in native Success after 13.70411386800697 active seconds and 13 input actions, recording one bay power transition with no panel damage or electrical-floor damage. Its inspected 12-second and 15-second video frames show approach to the bay and unbroken dark panels beside the abrupt wet-floor edge; they do not show a damaged panel. The 1080p run ended in native Success after 8.804244222992565 active seconds and five input actions, with no bay power, panel or electrical-floor events. Its four-second frame shows the blue player, yellow rival and red infected on a sparse flat road with placeholder focal geometry and oversized HUD panels. Both runs contain native combat events, zero restarts and no captured audio; neither establishes the long-form route or full evolving arena consequence. Later route beats and 600–1200 active seconds remain unqualified.
